create_file_insert_new_file: create a file record in the database using FilesTable.insert_new_file with user_id and FileForm data
read_file_get_file_by_id: read a file record from the database by its id using FilesTable.get_file_by_id
search_files_by_filename: search files by glob pattern on filename with optional user_id filter and pagination using FilesTable.search_files
update_file_update_file_by_id: update file hash, data, and metadata fields by id using FilesTable.update_file_by_id
delete_file_by_id: delete a file record from the database by its id using FilesTable.delete_file_by_id
